discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its physiological role, leading to GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology has transformed treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity, with major cardiovascular and renal benefits. It has already won the Lasker (2024) and Breakthrough Prize (2025), and the Karolinska committee has not yet honored it. Habener, Mojsov and Drucker are most often credited with identifying GLP-1(7-37) and establishing its incretin action, though Holst and Knudsen are alternative candidates.
